scientific_question: Can identical-state response panels expose a recurring callable across systems, allowing label-blind acquisition that transfers to new systems better than an alignment-destroyed capacity-matched control?

scope.generator: system-specific linear 4x4 term plus either a shared hidden smooth callable or an independently drawn smooth callable
supplied_structure: exactly eight of sixteen acquisition systems selected by label-blind centrality
one scalar outer coefficient for the callable
hidden_from_scientific_decisions: development group labels until predictions persist
scope.qualification: This is a controlled-probe recurrence-acquisition diagnostic, not passive single-trajectory inference, arbitrary graph discovery, unique factorization, or general physics discovery.

data.development_generation: only after both aligned-seed admission decisions are frozen

arms.aligned: SVD/centrality and callable learning preserve common-state row alignment
arms.shuffled: same method and capacity with independent deterministic row permutations per system
arms.random: same callable architecture with frozen random weights

model.optimizer: Adam lr=0.003, 400 full-batch updates, two fixed seeds

admission.development_opening: only if both aligned seeds pass
